title: hot pads
text: hot pads. These are soft... but pretty thin.  I used one tonight and it did protect hand, but I wish they were a bit thicker.  I washed them and dried them - came out great.  The gray is a dark charcoal - the trim edge is a bit different color than the terry cloth center - I didn't notice until after I had washed them.. but that's ok for me.  While they are on the thinner side, they are a bit larger in over size than my old ones. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Ritz Premium Terry Pot Holders & Hot Pads Without Pocket (2-Pack), 8.5"x8.25", High Heat Resistance, 100% Cotton, Dew
features: PREMIUM SIZE AND CONSTRUCTION. Well-crafted with soft 100% cotton, this set of 2 large Terry cloth pot holders measure 8.5 in. by 8.25 in. (21 cm by 20 cm).

PROTECT VALUED SURFACES. RITZ large potholders offer high-quality heat resistance and can also pull double duty and be employed as a hot pad for pots, pans, and baking dishes, safeguarding more delicate surfaces.
EASILY ACCESSIBLE. RITZ terry cloth potholders feature a convenient hanging loop that can be hung from a hook, oven and other kitchen appliances, doorknobs, and more.
COLORFUL. RITZ kitchen potholder sets are available an array of charming colors to accentuate your kitchen space.
MACHINE WASHABLE. This 2-piece RITZ Kitchen Pot Holder Set is easy to care for. These durable terry cloth pot holders are machine washable for hassle-free cleaning.
description: The RITZ® Royale Pot Holder is a dependable resource that dutifully keeps the heat off you in the kitchen. Durable 100% Terry Cloth Cotton is designed for maximum heat resistance when removing steamy cookware and bakeware from the oven, and pot holders can also pull double duty as hot pads to protect delicate surfaces. RITZ® Royale Pot Holder 2-packs come in a variety of charming colors that compliment our entire collection of kitchen towels, dish cloths, pot holders, and other kitchen essentials. Machine washable for hassle-free cleaning.
